children: Italy's unemployment rate was stable at 5.8% in July and employment levels were also little changed during the month, national statistics bureau ISTAT reported on Tuesday.
The unemployment rate was above a median forecast of 5.6% in a Reuters poll of seven analysts.
June's rate was revised up slightly to 5.8% from an originally reported 5.7%.
The youth unemployment rate, measuring job-seekers between 15 and 24 years old, rose in July to 18.9% from 18.7% in June, upwardly revised from 18.4%.
During the three months from May to July, employment was up 0.4% compared with the February-April period, with 91,000 more people in work.
The "inactivity rate," measuring people neither working nor looking for work, was stable in July at 32.8%.
Employment was up by 307,000 in July compared with the same month last year, an increase of 1.3%.
Italy's employment rate, one of the lowest in the euro zone, was stable at 63.2%.
